answer: The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the nectar queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 315 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the river. A 430 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
